title: Can Veeva Systems Inc. (VEEV)’s AI Platform Keep Pace With Eli Lilly and Company (LLY)’s Explosive Growth

content_html:
On August 11, Veeva Systems Inc. (NYSE:VEEV) announced that Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) committed to deploying Veeva Vault CRM globally. Vault CRM serves as the core infrastructure for "agentic commercial," Veeva's AI-driven commercial framework designed to modernize field engagement and speed medicine delivery. While Veeva serves as the tech engine driving efficiency in life sciences, Eli Lilly stands as the pharmaceutical titan creating those therapies. Both occupy distinct sectors, enterprise software versus biopharmaceuticals, yet their expanding partnership highlights how technology and drug development are becoming deeply intertwined.

Financial Health and Sector Dynamics

Since Veeva Systems Inc. (NYSE:VEEV) is a vertical SaaS vendor and Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) is a pharmaceutical manufacturer, direct financial comparison must account for their unique models. Enterprise tech relies on recurring subscriptions and high operating leverage, whereas biopharma depends on clinical trial velocity, manufacturing scale, and global regulatory approvals.

In its Fiscal 2027 First Quarter (ended April 30, 2026), Veeva delivered total revenue of $882.9 million, up 16% year-over-year, driven by $730.2 million in subscription revenue (up 15%). Non-GAAP EBIT reached $395 million, yielding an impressive operating margin above 44%.

Eli Lilly demonstrated remarkable top-line acceleration in Q2 2026. Revenue surged 48% year-over-year to $22.97 billion, propelled by explosive volume demand for GLP-1 therapies Mounjaro and Zepbound. Non-GAAP net income rose 32% to $7.49 billion ($8.38 per share). Lilly raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $85.0–$87.0 billion, underscoring its operational momentum despite absorbing $3.03 per share in acquired R&D charges. On August 7, Truist raised its price target on LLY to $1,376 from $1,370 with a Buy rating, citing substantial incretin volume growth offsetting pricing pressure.

Key Drivers and Catalyst Pipeline

LLY's momentum extends well beyond commercial execution into regulatory breakthroughs. On August 10, the UK's MHRA authorized Foundayo (orforglipron), making Britain the first European country to approve Lilly's once-daily oral GLP-1 pill for weight management and type 2 diabetes. Unlike existing oral options, Foundayo carries no food or water restrictions, positioning it as a major catalyst to expand treatment access globally.

Insider Monkey's Hedge Fund Data Analysis

The latest Insider Monkey hedge fund tracking data points to a modest decline in institutional participation across both equities in Q1 2026. Veeva Systems Inc. (NYSE:VEEV) was held by 62 hedge funds, down from 75 in Q4 2025. Among its major holders, Zevenbergen Capital Investments, led by Nancy Zevenbergen, held 111,527 shares valued at approximately $19.8 million, reflecting a 5% decline in activity. Meanwhile, Long Path Partners, led by William Brennan and Brian Nelson, held 52,738 shares worth about $9.4 million, representing a 61% increase in activity.

content_html_zh:
8 月 11 日，Veeva Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：VEEV）宣布礼来公司（纽约证券交易所代码：LLY）承诺在全球部署 Veeva Vault CRM。 Vault CRM 是“代理商业”的核心基础设施，这是 Veeva 的人工智能驱动的商业框架，旨在实现现场参与现代化并加快药品交付。 Veeva 是生命科学领域提高效率的技术引擎，而礼来公司则是创造这些疗法的制药巨头。 两者都占据不同的领域，企业软件与生物制药，但他们不断扩大的合作伙伴关系凸显了技术和药物开发如何紧密地交织在一起。

金融健康和行业动态

由于 Veeva Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：VEEV）是一家垂直 SaaS 供应商，而礼来公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：LLY）是一家制药制造商，因此直接进行财务比较必须考虑到他们独特的模式。 企业技术依赖于定期订阅和高运营杠杆，而生物制药则依赖于临床试验速度、制造规模和全球监管批准。

在 2027 财年第一季度（截至 2026 年 4 月 30 日），Veeva 的总收入为 8.829 亿美元，同比增长 16%，其中订阅收入为 7.302 亿美元（增长 15%）。 非 GAAP 息税前利润达到 3.95 亿美元，营业利润率高达 44% 以上，令人印象深刻。

礼来 (Eli Lilly) 在 2026 年第二季度表现出了显着的营收增长。 由于 GLP-1 疗法 Mounjaro 和 Zepbound 的爆炸性需求推动，收入同比飙升 48% 至 229.7 亿美元。 非 GAAP 净利润增长 32% 至 74.9 亿美元（每股 8.38 美元）。 礼来公司将 2026 年全年收入指引上调至 85.0-870 亿美元，尽管吸收了每股 3.03 美元的收购研发费用，但仍凸显了其运营势头。 8 月 7 日，Truist 将 LLY 的目标价格从 1,370 美元上调至 1,376 美元，并给予买入评级，理由是肠促胰岛素销量的大幅增长抵消了定价压力。

关键驱动因素和催化剂管道

LLY 的发展势头远远超出了商业执行领域，还突破了监管领域。 8月10日，英国MHRA授权Foundayo（orforglipron），使英国成为第一个批准礼来公司每日一次口服GLP-1药丸用于体重管理和2型糖尿病的欧洲国家。 与现有的口服药物不同，Foundayo 没有食物或水的限制，这使其成为扩大全球治疗范围的主要催化剂。

Insider Monkey 的对冲基金数据分析

最新的 Insider Monkey 对冲基金跟踪数据显示，2026 年第一季度机构对这两种股票的参与度略有下降。 Veeva Systems Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：VEEV）由 62 家对冲基金持有，低于 2025 年第四季度的 75 家。 在其主要股东中，由 Nancy Zevenbergen 领导的 Zevenbergen Capital Investments 持有 111,527 股，价值约 1,980 万美元，反映出活跃度下降了 5%。 与此同时，由 William Brennan 和 Brian Nelson 领导的 Long Path Partners 持有 52,738 股，价值约 940 万美元，活跃度增加了 61%。
